title: Lightly Brined Thai Provola Boat Noodles
description: A funky and nostalgic Thai dish featuring provola cheese in a brine-wet and gluten-free-friendly boat noodle form
instructions: Bring the broth to a boil in a large pot and then reduce the heat to a simmer
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, white pepper, and salt to the broth and stir to combine
Add the sliced provola cheese to the broth and let it melt and infuse for 5 minutes
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and drain well
Add the cooked noodles to the broth and let it cook for an additional 2 minutes
Add the bean sprouts and sliced pork or chicken to the broth and cook for 1 minute
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
Ladle the noodles and broth into bowls and serve immediately
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
